V7 DESIGN · FIT PENDING

KITTY V7. Team PROMETHEUS.

Raised PROMETHEUS lettering sits above the front collar; KITTY sits below the rear tail mount so the name stays visible. The folded collar, faceted neck cuff, clipped phone bezel and detachable tail complete the V7 body. The separate STL set contains 13 body parts; use your purchased wheels, motors and phone.

Review the shape

PROMETHEUS and KITTY are raised CAD geometry fused into their covers. They print in the shell material and can be painted after printing. The chest fold, neck cuff and ear facets share the same angular detail. Two rear tie eyes keep the proposed cable-tidying points within the existing part count. Aqua eyes are display placeholders.

The tail uses a keyed socket and proposed M3 cross screw, above the service openings. Remove the screw, then follow the small arrow on the screw-entry side and pull rearward. The arrow shows direction only. Tail joint shows a 35 mm exploded gap; the screw is omitted. The proposed 0.4 mm fit clearance still needs a sample.

Before printing the separate parts

The draft uses your 62 mm wheel diameter and 61 × 20 mm motor length/width. We still need motor height and shaft position, wheel hub fit, caster, AA holder, phone case/camera access, and printer bed/material/nozzle.

Each part needs fit and slicer/support review. Print only the separate parts in STL_PARTS/ from the V7 ZIP. Wheels, motors, phone and electronics in this viewer are references; their meshes are excluded from that folder. The V7 design export is not a physically fit-verified release.
